inspiration: Four-phase ability timing: a cast time paired with start, middle and end animation hooks and separate activation and execution effect IDs (data/abilityIDs.csv header). Use the phase structure, not the names.
Clothing as colourways: one model ID plus a colour ID per item gives many looks (data/mxoClothing.csv header). Use for armour recolours.
Large emote library with prefixed names (data/animations.txt, 5442 entries). Use a smaller own gesture set with consistent prefixes.
Per-faction numeric standing with alignment and reputation (README chat-command section). Use the mechanic with our own factions and scale.
Mission template: one data node carries title, experience, info reward and objective counts (data/missions/mission_zion_1.xml). Use the template shape only.
Sparse fast-travel nodes (README feature list: signposts, hyperjump, teleport through hardlines). Use sparse travel nodes with our own names.

briefs.label: colourway armour family
briefs.why: one model with several colour IDs gives a whole armour family for little art cost
briefs.keep: one model, many colour IDs; clothing slot types

briefs.label: four-phase telegraphed ability
briefs.why: a clear wind-up, mid and end pose lets players read an attack before it lands
briefs.keep: cast split into three animation phases; separate activation and impact effects
briefs.change: our own telegraph shapes and timing numbers; different impact VFX

briefs.label: faction standing
briefs.why: a numeric standing per faction gives every choice a visible consequence
briefs.change: our own factions, names and scale

briefs.label: mission reward template

briefs.keep: reward fields and objective counts on one node
briefs.change: our own objective types and reward curve
